items.title: Luther Henderson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think I did two, two arrangements. ... for Ozzie.

ctx.x: I have this record. Now correct me if I'm wrong but are you listed as composer?

Arranger. If I'm listed it’s as an arranger. I remember one was “You'd Better Know It” is one. There was another one but I can't remember exactly what it was. You'd Better Know It. Ozzie Bailey, one of the things that Ozzie Bailey sang, I think, I did a couple and Strayhorn did a couple for Ozzie. Seems to have been another one and I can't remember what it was. I think I did two, two arrangements.
